Ravi M: Flagging PR #523 — 'Zephyr-compat and card examples' update. It touches supported models table, seq ceilings, and SDK snippets. Need eyes on the examples and the runtime compatibility pointer. cc @Ana @Priya
Ana C: I'll review the sdk snippets and node/python examples. Any fresh benchmarks to surface?
Ravi M: Quick numbers from the infra run: 1024-seq throughput ~340 tok/s on our mid-sized GPU pool, median latency ~75ms. Note: the 8-bit quantized build currently disables KV cache; added a note in the PR.
Priya D: I'll handle the limits table. We should move the Zephyr family to a single row in the supported models matrix and add "seq ceiling: 4096 (recommended: 2048 for latency-sensitive flows)". Also add recommended batch sizes.
Ana C: Proposed python snippet to include pinning guidance:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
# pin model version for Dedicated
out = client.generate(model='zephyr-mini-4b@v3.1.0', input='Summarize customer feedback')
print(out.text)
```
Ana C: I'll also add a Node.js equivalent.
docs-bot: Deploy preview for PR #523: https://deploy-preview-docs.redwood-inference.io/523  staging build passed, anchor check failed (zephyr anchor mismatch)
Ravi M: Anchor mismatch likely caused by the compat page reorganization. Priya, can you confirm the correct anchor and add a short redirect?
Priya D: Found it. Anchor changed from `#zephyr-family` to `#zephyr-mini`. Pushed a tiny fix and an inline note mapping the family names.
Ana C: Small wording suggestion: replace "quant may reduce accuracy" with "quantization may introduce a small change in output quality; validate on your eval set."
Priya D: Done. Also added a short migration checklist for Dedicated: pin to `@v3.1.0`, test with eval prompts, and prefer batch size 4 for low-latency, 24 for throughput.
Ravi M: Also add a short note about streaming: "Streaming with quant variants may fall back to a compatible float variant for partial tokens".
Ana C: Added both python and node pin examples and a one-liner for CLI users. Re-ran preview.
docs-bot: Deploy preview re-run for PR #523: all checks passed.
Ravi M: Thanks team. I'll merge after CI. If anything else crops up, reply here and we'll triage. :shipit:
